hook.name: DeltaHook
hook.description: Applies zone-based ETH swap taxes (3–12% on buys/sells) relative to the token's all-time high price, with a decaying 30% anti-snipe launch tax over 30 minutes and ETH rebates for buys in peak/dip zones. Collects taxes via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and optionally enforces a same-block sell guard to prevent sandwich attacks.
